review.why: Drafts job-application short answers and selection-criteria responses from the user's own evidence, within word limits.
review.summary: Reads the question, limits, target role and the user's evidence, picks an approach for the question type (why this role, an achievement, a criterion, years of experience, tools, availability, work authorization, salary), drafts the answer and counts it against the limit. It returns question, answer and count, then the open questions. It never submits a form.
strengths: Refuses to invent passion, round up years or infer legal eligibility
Stops when the application forbids AI help and says what it can still do
Worked example of a truthful answer to a years-of-experience field
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Sensitive fields (disability, identity, declarations) are left to the user
Quality depends on the evidence the user supplies
